records.failure_scenario: If the user backgrounds the tab or the app force-navigates away from #pageIntro while the ~6.6s cinematic is mid-flight, the requestAnimationFrame loop keeps drawing to #brandCanvas (getBoundingClientRect + 2D fillRect/arc/text calls every frame) for up to the remaining duration, because nothing calls BrandReveal.skip() on those transitions. Bounded (max ~6.6s), not infinite, but a real violation of 1=1 during that window.
records.planned_fix: Gate B: add a document.hidden check inside loop() that calls _finish() immediately (matching the pattern used by every other engine in this file), and wire a visibilitychange listener to call BrandReveal.skip() if _alive.
